name: Aerona
source:
You have no memory of the warrior woman, and it breaks her heart. You'd planned a life together, she tells you. Now your plans are on hold, and your relationship is uncertain.

[From [url=https://maneki-mushi.itch.io/theherosjourney]itch.io[/url]]
